t: This is the Army and Navy Club, a private members' club known to everyone as The Rag. It was founded in 1837 for officers of the British Army, the Royal Navy and the Royal Marines. Membership is open to those who hold or have held a commission in the British or Commonwealth armed forces, and the club now accepts non-military members too. General Sir William Peyton died here. He served as Military Secretary to the British Expeditionary Force from 1916 to 1918, and was Delhi Herald of Arms Extraordinary at the time of the Delhi Durbar of 1911.
